android.desc:
Transform your Android TV into a refined living room experience.

ChillHub replaces your default Android TV home screen with a clean, modern launcher designed around simplicity and elegance. No clutter. No ads. Just your apps, your content, and a beautiful backdrop.

A HOME SCREEN THAT FEELS PREMIUM
A spacious layout with a bottom dock for your most-used apps, a full app grid above, and a sleek top shelf that surfaces your Continue Watching content — all wrapped in smooth animations and cinematic transitions.

STUNNING BACKGROUNDS & THEMES
Choose from 11 handcrafted theme collections — Aurora, Cosmos, Peaks, Waves, Forest, Dunes, and more — each with multiple image variants. Fine-tune the look with 10 blur levels and 3 overlay styles for thousands of possible combinations. Make it yours.

SMART APP SORTING
Your most-used apps rise to the top automatically. Or sort alphabetically, or set a fully custom order — your choice. Hide apps you never use and keep your grid clean.

CONTINUE WATCHING, FRONT AND CENTER
ChillHub surfaces your in-progress content right on the home screen via Android's WatchNext API. See what you were watching and jump back in with one click — no digging through apps.

CUSTOMIZABLE HEADER
Display the time, date, and Wi-Fi status in a minimal header pill. Choose your preferred date format, reorder controls, or hide them entirely for maximum minimalism.

BUILT FOR YOUR TV
Designed exclusively for the big screen. Full D-pad and remote control navigation, fast boot times, and rock-solid stability — because your launcher should never crash.

FEATURES
  • Premium dock with 6 pinned apps
  • Custom app icons — set any image URL as an app icon
  • Folders — organize your apps into groups
  • Smooth focus animations and transitions
  • 11 theme bundles with blur and overlay controls
  • Smart sorting by usage, alphabetical, or custom order
  • Continue Watching top shelf via WatchNext (can be toggled off)
  • Hide and manage apps easily
  • Real-time Wi-Fi / Ethernet status indicator
  • Configurable clock and date display
  • Long-press app menu: reorder, hide, change icon, uninstall, app info
  • Automatic update notifications
  • Works standalone — no extra apps required
  • No ads. No tracking. No bloat.

WORKS WITH EVERY ANDROID TV
Compatible with Android TV boxes, Google TV devices, Fire TV (sideload), and smart TVs running Android TV OS. Requires Android 7.0+.
